text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This is Ticket! Go straight for a while,
then VROOM into that left
curve. Then when
the engine goes SCREEE, you'll find the
plane!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Teio here! I have no idea what any of that
means, so give me proper
directions! Over!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So this is the prototype... The wings are
damaged, but the engine seems to be
intact. If that's the case,
we can restore the
machine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Taishin, can you handle this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I'll need to take it apart so it
can be
loaded onto the truck. I'll
work on fixing
what I can while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Amazing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(You can see the minute adjustments
they've made in the angle of the welding,
and there are other signs of the insides
being reworked. Hayahide was right—it's
clear a lot of time and effort went into
this plane...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(But... even with all the adjustments,
they
couldn't reach their goal...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
How's it looking, Taishin?! Do you think
you can use your talents as a
Mechawork
Engineer to fix the plane?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uh... Hm? There's a component
that's not included in her current
test
model. Is this the change she said caused
the crash? But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it's a mistake...
If anything, the plane probably flew as
far as it did because of her addition. The
improvements we need to make are
obvious at a glance too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For real?! I'm soooo relieved!
I bet that'll
take away from some of the
guilt she was
feeling!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I used to think...
I didn't need to dwell on
mistakes or losses. After
all, why would I
want to wallow in my own weakness?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (But now...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We've finished loading the wreckage.
Teio, you can drive it back to
the
workshop.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-whoa! Yikes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It seems it won't steer properly due to
the heavy load. I
miscalculated—I thought that
driving this truck would be the same as 
driving any other vehicle.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe,
but it's too soon to call it quits just
yet!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's just a little setback, but we're not going to let it stop us! We're gonna see that plane fly!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
One genius driver, at your service! With
my super truck-driving techniques, getting
this baby to our destination will be a
piece of
cake!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We worked our butts off to get this thing
moving. We can't let
everyone's hard work
go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll pull off something even more
impressive than Double Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: That's Twin Turbo! Oh! But you got half of it right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone! We're gonna floor it!
Oof... Owww...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hn? I thought I heard a voice... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ticket here! There's another vehicle
coming up from behind you! The
driver's
yelling something!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Vehicle? Oh! Yeah,
I see it! It's coming at
us super fast!

Waaaait! Give it baaaack! Darn airplane
thieeeves!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A-airplane thieves?! Stop the truck!

I see. You're hauling the plane on behalf
of its owner. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we could clear up this
misunderstanding. However, who are
you?
Why were you chasing after us—or rather,
the airplane?

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I make a living studying metals, and I've
been making trips out here to examine the
wreckage. I'd appreciate it if you didn't
remove my
precious specimen!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: 'Scuse you, but this plane belongs to us.

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so it would seem. That's why I'm
asking you to give it to me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid that's not possible. As you can
see, we've already retrieved the plane. We
want to use its technology as a
springboard for the
next test model.

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's excellent news! Actually,
I was
examining this aircraft's
engine, and its
specs were most impressive!

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what sort of eccentric would
attempt to fly in this hunk of metal, but
there's plenty in the design to
convince me that it's quite
possible!

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Would the aircraft be able to fly if a
different metal is used? Perhaps
if we used
a steel alloy of my own composition!

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I would love to see a plane made from my
steel alloy take to the sky!
I'm quite
invested, you see.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying this plane inspired your
dream too?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're just like our friend! This plane is the common thread that binds you! H-how emotional! Waaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...The old engineer's plane called to this
researcher.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(If the plane hadn't crashed...
If we hadn't
come to retrieve it... Then
we never would
have met this person.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Hayahide said mistakes are part of this
project's history... Maybe this
is what she
meant.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm also here as a result of my history.
If I
won every single race with
ease...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...My relationships with everybody would
probably be very
different.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Listen... Would you mind...
lending us your
help?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There's... We've got someone who works
mainly on the research side.
We'd like you
to come with us and lend her a hand.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. You beat me to the punch. I'd be
honored to join the
research team!
